_doc: Declarative API contracts for the smoke test.
Each entry under `checks` describes ONE request and what shape the
frontend expects in return. The smoke runner reads this file, makes
2. Every key in `expect_keys` is present at the response root
every key in `expect_item_keys` is present on each item under
Why this exists: 5 of the last ~12 bug-fixes were field-name
mismatches across the FE/BE boundary (priceFormatted missing from
/orders; full_name vs fullName; etc.). A flat JSON contract file
is the cheapest way to catch those before the user does.
To add an endpoint: drop a new object into `checks`. No code change

checks.name: GET /api/orders/pending
checks._note: PendingOrdersSection reads camelCase, but order_number is the single field that's snake-case-only on this endpoint (inconsistent — backend should also expose orderNumber). Tracked in ROADMAP_HARDENING.

checks.name: GET /api/users
checks._note: UserManagementTab reads user.fullName (camelCase) but backend currently returns full_name. Latent mismatch — see ROADMAP_HARDENING.md.

checks.name: GET /api/inventory (station 1)
checks._note: Response shape varies by station; just checking 200 is enough to confirm route is up.

checks.name: GET /api/diagnostics/database (Emergency tab)
checks._note: Recent bug: support_role_required rejected demo tokens. Smoke catches that regressing.

checks.name: GET /api/pricing-settings
checks._note: vip_free is the comp-VIP toggle. Missing it = regression of the VIP-free feature.

checks.name: GET /api/catalog/milk
checks._note: Catalog is the source of truth for option lists. Missing keys here = regression of the catalog feature; every UI reads from it.

checks.name: GET /api/walkin-defaults
checks._note: Walk-in dialog reads from this to seed initial values. Missing fields = regression of the per-event walk-in defaults feature.
